newsitem.title: USA: First Charter board sets 20 pct stock div.
newsitem.headline: First Charter board sets 20 pct stock div.

text.p: First Charter Corp said on Wednesday that its dirctors had declared a 20 percent stock dividend.

In addition, the board adjusted the rate of the quarterly cash dividend for First Charter common stock from $0.15 per share to $0.125 per share to reflect the 20 percent stock dividend, First Charter said.
It also declared a cash dividend of $.125 per share to be paid on post-dividend shares.
The dividend is payable on July 15, to shareholders of record on June 20, the company said.
